t: This is the site of Townhouse Studios, on Goldhawk Road in Shepherd's Bush. The Town House was a recording studio built in 1978 under the direction of Richard Branson for Virgin Records. Branson co-founded the Virgin Group in 1970, and this studio was part of that Virgin story. The studios changed hands over the years and finally stopped operating in 2008. Where they once stood, there are now luxury apartments, so the music has gone, and what you see is residential.
